name: Tyson
description: Dragoon partner — original-generation anime-inspired active battle skills.

skills.name: Champion’s Spirit
skills.description: For 2 rounds, recover 25% of HP damage received, capped at 8% maximum HP per round. Surviving hits only.

skills.name: Galaxy Storm
skills.description: Your next Attack gains 10% damage per consecutive Attack round, including this round; maximum 30%.

skills.name: Galaxy Turbo Twister
skills.description: Use with Special: a tornado lasts 2 rounds. Each round end deals 32% ATK damage through normal DEF and reductions, with an independent 44% chance to crit for double damage. Enemy moves cost +0.7 battle stamina while active. Once per battle.
